tours.name: Big Almaty Lake
tours.hint: 5 hours door to door. Runs all year; in winter the road may close after heavy snow.

tours.name: Issyk lake and Turgen waterfalls
tours.hint: About 8 hours. April to November; the lake road is closed after heavy snow.

tours.name: Charyn Canyon
tours.hint: About 11 hours door to door. Runs all year; best light in spring and autumn.

tours.name: Charyn, Kolsai and Kaindy
tours.hint: 16 hours door to door, 6:00 to 22:00. April to October, when the Kaindy road is open.

tours.name: Assy Plateau and Turgen gorge
tours.hint: About 10 hours. May to October; the plateau road is under snow the rest of the year.

tours.name: Tamgaly-Tas and the Ili river
tours.hint: About 7 hours. Runs all year; very hot in July and August; start early.

tours.name: Kolsai Lakes and Kaindy
tours.hint: Two days with a night in Saty. April to October.

tours.name: Altyn-Emel
tours.hint: Two days with a night in Basshi. March to November; July and August are hot on the dune.
